input_prompt: Design a 4X space game with: 8 factions, procedural galaxy, tech tree (200+ techs), diplomacy, trade routes, fleet combat, planetary management, espionage

rules.name: Resource Management
rules.description: Players must manage resources (minerals, energy, etc.) to build and maintain their empire.

rules.name: Tech Tree Progression
rules.description: Players can research new technologies to improve their empire's capabilities.

rules.name: Diplomacy and Trade
rules.description: Players can interact with other factions through diplomacy and trade, forming alliances or rivalries.

rules.name: Fleet Combat
rules.description: Players can engage in space battles with other factions to defend their territory or expand their empire.

rules.name: Planetary Management
rules.description: Players can manage their planets, building infrastructure and harvesting resources.

rules.name: Espionage
rules.description: Players can gather intelligence on other factions to gain an advantage in diplomacy, trade, or combat.

interactions.result: Unlock new technologies and improve empire capabilities
Gain access to shared resources and trade agreements
Engage in fleet combat and potentially gain territory
Gain insight into enemy faction's plans and capabilities

transitions.trigger: Player selects a planet to explore
Player is attacked by another faction
Player surrenders or forms an alliance

implementation_steps: Implement procedural galaxy generation using a combination of algorithms and data structures.
Design and implement the tech tree system, including research and unlocking mechanics.
Develop the diplomacy system, including diplomatic relations and trade agreements.
Create the fleet system, including ship design and combat resolution.
Implement the planetary system, including planet generation and infrastructure building.
Develop the espionage system, including spy networks and intelligence gathering.
